Q1. What types of lifts do you supply?
We supply passenger, home, hospital, goods, hydraulic, and MRL lifts.

Typically, installation takes 4–8 weeks, depending on specifications.
Q3. Do you offer warranty and maintenance for lifts?
Yes, all lifts come with manufacturer warranties and AMC options.

Yes, BG Elevators offers tailor-made lifts for unique building requirements.
